met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over north Chhattisgarh & neighbourhood lies over northeast Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood at 0830 hours IST of today, the 22nd November, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs from east Madhya Pradesh to Manipur across cyclonic circulation associated with northeast Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood, Jharkhand, Bihar, north Gangetic West Bengal & Bangladesh at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 71°E to the north of Lat. 30°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Madhya Maharashtra & neighbourhood lies over south Gujrat and adjoining north Maharashtra at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
A trough in easterlies runs from Southwest Bay of Bengal to north Coastal Andhra Pradesh across Westcentral Bay of Bengal and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North coastal Andhra Pradesh and adjoining westcentral Bay of Bengal at 1.5 km above mean sea level merged with the above trough.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Arunachal Pradesh & neighbourhood lies over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Nagaland & neighbourhoodat 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
